Components / Surfaces

Address picker

.dr-sheet--steady · .dr-search · .dr-picker__list · __item · __lead · __label · __sub · components/sheet.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

Pickup address

  1. 1.dr-sheet__titleNamed after the row that opened the sheet: Pickup address, Drop-off address or Address.
  2. 2.dr-searchThe field, 341 × 44, radius 10. Typed text is 15px --text-primary on --bg-well, 13.33:1; the placeholder Search address is --text-muted, 5.51:1. The field has no label of its own: it is named by the sheet's title (aria-labelledby). It opens holding the row's current address and takes focus, so the keyboard rises and the sheet rides on it.
  3. 3.dr-picker__leadA 20px leading glyph in --text-muted on the --bg-surface list, 5.95:1, 12px before the label. It is the one place a picker row shows a .dr-ic other than the current-item tick. It is aria-hidden and never carries meaning on its own.
  4. 4.dr-picker__subThe sub-line, 12.5/400 in --text-muted, 5.95:1. It says in words what the glyph shows.
  5. 5.dr-sheet__actionsDone over Cancel, 341 × 44 each. With --steady they take margin-top: auto and stay on the floor of the sheet.

States

Light

Try it: hover, press, Tab. Follows the theme switch above.

Two rows of the list, from the Pickup address sheet on listings. The sheet's Done and Cancel take the button states.

When to use

The address picker is the sheet where an address is typed or chosen. One sheet serves From, To and Where on the finder. A tap on a route row opens it, never focus on the row. With the keyboard up at the 375 frame it measures 412.8 tall, top at 63.2, bottom on the keyboard's 476, overlap 0. Done is 4.93% of the frame, the only green above the scrim.

A tapped row is taken at once. Done takes what was typed. Cancel, the scrim and Escape change nothing. A tap does not move focus off the field, so the keyboard stays up until the tap lands.

The first row uses the user's words, Use my location, not GPS or geolocation (voice P4). Addresses are written in the product's short form, Podil, 21, and the sub-line says why a row is there: Saved address, Recent. The status line counts results, 1 address, 2 addresses or No matching address, and does not count Use my location.

Sources: DESIGN.md § The search home (Address drawer) · inventory.md § 1 Address drawer · microcopy.md § listings, Address drawer · voice.md P4 · ui/kit.html § Address picker

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Address

Photo and inspection have one place, so the Where row opens the same sheet titled Address. The search field, the list and Done over Cancel are the same. Only listings and its three states (listings-error, listings-filters, listings-loading) build this sheet, and all four build it identically.

Don’t

A bare search field on the home screen in place of the route row. The typing belongs in this sheet. On the finder the row is a <button aria-haspopup="dialog"> that opens on a tap (WCAG 3.2.1, 4.1.2); see the finder. For a value chosen from a short fixed list, with nothing to type, use the plain sheet picker without a search field.
